sloka: उपस्थासमनुज्ञाप्य प्रविवेश निवेशन्म् ।अद्य रामाभिषेको वै प्रसिद्ध इति जज्ञिवान् ॥२-१०-१०॥
transliteration: upasthāsamanujñāpya praviveśa niveśanm ।adya rāmābhiṣeko vai prasiddha iti jajñivān ॥2-10-10॥

translations.english: Aware of the fact that Rama's installation ceremony was known to everybody by then he who had subdued his senses entered the inner apartment to convey it to one worthy of such pleasant news.
translations.hindi: नीलकमल की तरह श्याम शरीर वाला, लंबी भुजाओं बाला तथा सुन्दर श्रीराम को क्या मैं दणडकवन में भेज सकता हुँ?
